cases.name: Manifold Insights
cases.text: Reveal the top ten cards of your library. Starting with the next opponent in turn order, each opponent chooses a different nonland card from among them. Put the chosen cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cases.name: Manifold Insights
cases.text: Reveal the top five cards of your library. Starting with the next opponent in turn order, each opponent chooses a different noncreature card from among them. Put the chosen cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cases.name: Manifold Insights
cases.text: Reveal the top five cards of your library. Starting with the next opponent in turn order, each opponent chooses a different noncreature card from among them. Put the chosen cards into your graveyard and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cases.name: Niv-Mizzet Reborn
cases.text:
Flying
When Niv-Mizzet enters, reveal the top ten cards of your library. For each color pair, choose a card that's exactly those colors from among them. Put the chosen cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
